description: Reduce persisted and flattened artwork plane clearance from 7cm to 7mm, retaining canonical wall parent, existing saved transforms and world-scale compensation.
notes: Client rendering-only change. No server, snapshots, assets or persistence modifications.
Source regression tests have been updated to expect the 7mm clearance but are not needed for the Aippy runtime import.
This does not claim to fix artwork absent after reconnect; separate investigation of artwork loading/visibility and parent visibility is still required.
